title: Understand the Dashboard
summary: What each block of the home dashboard shows: the day, the month, the branches, the services, patients per day and the trend.

steps.title: Menu → Dashboard
steps.details: The Dashboard is the clinic's home screen.

steps.title: Today
steps.details: Production is what was invoiced today and Collections what was collected. Visits counts attended appointments, how many distinct patients and out of how many booked. Cash result is what was collected minus expenses. Each figure is compared with the same weekday last week.

steps.title: Month to date
steps.details: The same added up since the 1st of the month, compared with last month. Collections show what percentage of production has already come in; Monthly expenses comes from the expenses entered in Cashier.

steps.title: Branches
steps.details: Compares the branches in the chosen period: production, visits, patients, average ticket and no-shows. Each invoice's branch is estimated from the patient's closest appointment.

steps.title: Best-selling services
steps.details: The 6 services with the highest invoicing in the chosen period and branch.

steps.title: Patients per day
steps.details: Patients seen, new and returning. With long periods it's grouped by week or month. Each bar counts unique patients, which is why the bars don't add up to the total.

steps.title: Trend
steps.details: The last 6 months per metric, with the change against the previous month. It doesn't depend on the chosen period; the current month shows as partial.
